answer: To resist sybils, every new identity starts on a rate-limited island where it may post bonded claims but cannot attest. Promotion up a reputation trellis requires a streak of peer-countersigned unique work plus an ivory stake locked against later equivocation. If two identities reuse the same work graph or key-derivation pattern, both stakes are slashed and both drop back to the island. Disposable keys therefore cannot buy attestation weight cheaper than honest labor.
